Beginning of Wave 7 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|A new enemy incoming!|Beginning of Wave 5 ([[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Slow''' is an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appears in the [[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Challenge Trials]], [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]], [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]], Basic Arena [[PVP]] and Molten Arena [[PVP]] modes, as well as the tutorial and first chapters of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. As the name of it suggests, it is a slow, but relatively strong enemy that requires tower upgrades to be countered. The '''Slow''' also has a chance to be spawned by the [[Mystery]] upon its death in the [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode. The [[Grave Digger]] had a chance to spawn the '''Slow''' with its ''Triumphing Sheol'' ability in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. The '''Slow''' was also formerly spawned by the [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]] before its replacement. In [[The Heights]], the '''Slow''' could have been spawned by the [[Swordmaster]] or from the [[Tombstone]] when it was destroyed. It also appeared as parts of the [[SFOTH Event]], [[Metaverse Champions Event]], [[The Classic Event]] and [[The Takeover Event]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Slow''' is a humanoid with a greyish-sand skin color as well as a brown torso and legs. It is faceless and lightly covered in dirt. It has two animations that are randomly chosen. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Slow''' had grey skin, as well as a brown torso and legs. It was faceless. It initially had one animation. After the [[V1.20.0|Intermediate Mode Update]], it had two animations that were randomly chosen. }} |Legacy |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Slow''' has a khaki–grey skin color, as well as a dark brown torso and legs. It has a diagonal scar on its face. |Current (Enemies Beta) |The current version of the [[Enemies Beta]] '''Slow''' has grey skin, as well as a brown torso and legs. It is faceless. |Version 3 |The third version of the '''Slow''' is similar to the current version, except it had a sad face and it walked with its head tilted down. |Version 2 |The second version of the '''Slow''' had a dark greyish-green skin color, a brown torso and dark green legs. It had a drooling zombie face. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Slow''' had a dark grey skin color, a dark grey torso and dark green legs. It had a drooling zombie face. }} }} ==Strategy== *Most towers can deal with the '''Slow''' effectively. **Any tower catered towards early game, like the [[Soldier]], [[Assassin]], [[Brawler]], [[Cowboy]], [[Militant]] or [[Cowboy]] is recommended. **It is unnecessary to try to get stronger, more expensive towers like the [[Minigunner]] solely to deal with '''Slows''', as cheaper options fare well against them already. **Towers that can deal damage to multiple enemies are especially effective against '''Slows''' as they spawn in hordes. Such towers include the [[Demoman]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Pyromancer]] and [[Shotgunner]]. *While not recommended if you do not have high base health, it is an option to avoid defending against the first few waves of '''Slows''' and simply let them reach the exit, as their low health makes it unlikely to make you lose. **You can use the [[Medic]] to heal the base health back, but it is not necessary. **As you are not spending money on defenses, you can use the [[Farm]] more effectively for the first few waves to get better towers when stronger enemies appear. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|
